history.detail: Validating bounding box and date inputs.
Discovering Sentinel-1 pair and clear-sky Sentinel-2 metadata in Copernicus STAC.
Acquiring Sentinel-1 scenes (caller-supplied or auto-downloaded from Planetary Computer STAC).
Checked VV/VH dB values, CRS, alignment, AOI coverage; orbit/date tags incomplete; operator must verify the supplied pair.
Running flood segmentation with DEM slope gating and temporal change screening.
Assessing building, road, and bridge exposure using approved wording.
Calculating road access using the pre-event OSM snapshot.
Compiling the one-page situation report and interactive map dashboard.
Job finished successfully. Output ready in multimodal-ai\outputs\e2e_test_job
